title: Access, permissions, RLS/FLS, write-path guards

items.title: Row-level security: restricted member sees only their rows; admin sees all
personas: restricted member on an OWD-private object
steps: as the restricted member, list an OWD-private object over the data API
as admin, list the same object
compare against the ground-truth row set

acceptance.clause: member reads return only owned/shared rows; admin reads return the full set — BOTH sides verified, absence and presence
acceptance.verify: row-set comparison per persona; the auto-derived RLS proofs in @objectstack/verify (runRlsProofs) cover this app-agnostically — rls-consistent verdict required, rls-hole is a FAIL
acceptance.evidence: the two listings + the verify run verdict

history.change: initial — standing P0, delegating the systematic sweep to @objectstack/verify and keeping the persona spot-check manual

items.title: Write-path guards: readonly strip, owner_id forge/transfer denied, bulk validation
personas: non-admin member (owner forge is only meaningful non-privileged)
steps: REST-INSERT and UPDATE a readonly:true field; re-read the row
as the non-admin, attempt an insert forging another user's owner_id and an update transferring it
bulk-update a set that violates a validation rule

acceptance.clause: readonly fields are stripped on INSERT and UPDATE (value unchanged server-side)
acceptance.verify: post-write reads show the readonly field untouched

acceptance.clause: owner_id forge and transfer are denied for non-privileged users; bulk inserts stamp the current user
acceptance.verify: forge/transfer attempts rejected; empty-owner bulk insert rows land stamped with the caller

acceptance.clause: bulk update runs validation rules per row (the updateMany call-site gap of #3106 must not reproduce)
acceptance.verify: a bulk update violating a rule is rejected/skipped per row, not silently applied

history.change: initial — merged from #3358 §9 and the 15.1 A-group rows these dogfood tests pin

items.title: Record-grained access explain shows per-layer attribution and a verdict
steps: in the access explain panel, pick user + object + record

acceptance.clause: the panel attributes access per layer (permission set → position → sharing → row rules) and renders a record.visible verdict naming the deciding layer
acceptance.verify: screenshot shows all layers with the verdict; spot-check the verdict against an actual read as that user (server truth)

history.change: initial import from #3358, adding the impersonated-read cross-check

items.title: A read-only package actually locks Studio editing surfaces
steps: open the permission matrix / object designer on a read-only package

acceptance.clause: the read-only badge renders AND the controls are actually disabled — checkboxes/Save inert, edit affordances absent
acceptance.verify: after screenshot confirms render, assert disabled state on the controls (a badge alone is not a lock)
